content.title: Management of Sustained Monomorphic VT

actions.no: Consider ECG morphology for idiopathic VT

actions.decision: Typical ECG morphology for idiopathic VT
actions.action: Use Verapamil or beta blocker (Class IIa)

interventions: IV procainamide (Class IIa) for VT termination
clinical_actions.note: Therapy guided by underlying heart disease or Catheter ablation (Class I)

notes: Verapamil sensitive VT may use verapamil or beta blockers for acute termination
Catheter ablation can be considered for VT termination (Class I)
